    function initTheme() {
      const savedTheme = localStorage.getItem("synapse-theme");
      const systemPrefersDark = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches;
      
      if (savedTheme === "dark" || (!savedTheme && systemPrefersDark)) {
        document.documentElement.classList.add("dark");
      } else {
        document.documentElement.classList.remove("dark");
      }
    }

    function toggleTheme() {
      const isDark = document.documentElement.classList.toggle("dark");
      localStorage.setItem("synapse-theme", isDark ? "dark" : "light");
    }

    async function syncWithPlatformStorage() {
      if (!archestraSDKReady) return;
      try {
        const storedItems = await window.archestra.storage.user.list();
        if (storedItems && storedItems.length > 0) {
          let foundTasks = storedItems.find(i => i.key === "synapse-tasks");
          let foundNotices = storedItems.find(i => i.key === "synapse-notices");
          let foundEvents = storedItems.find(i => i.key === "synapse-events");
          let foundBrief = storedItems.find(i => i.key === "synapse-brief");
          let foundTimer = storedItems.find(i => i.key === "synapse-timer-playlist");
          let foundEmailPerm = storedItems.find(i => i.key === "synapse-email-perm");
          let foundAutoScan = storedItems.find(i => i.key === "synapse-autoscan-launch");

          if (foundTasks) state.tasks = foundTasks.value;
          if (foundNotices) state.notices = foundNotices.value;
          if (foundEvents) state.events = foundEvents.value;
          if (foundBrief) state.dailyBrief = foundBrief.value;
          if (foundTimer) state.selectedPlaylist = foundTimer.value;
          if (foundEmailPerm) state.emailPermission = Boolean(foundEmailPerm.value);
          if (foundAutoScan) state.autoScanOnLaunch = Boolean(foundAutoScan.value);
        } else {
          await window.archestra.storage.user.set("synapse-tasks", state.tasks);
          await window.archestra.storage.user.set("synapse-notices", state.notices);
          await window.archestra.storage.user.set("synapse-events", state.events);
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("Storage syncing exception:", err);
      }
    }

    async function persistKey(key, data) {
      if (!archestraSDKReady) return;
      try {
        await window.archestra.storage.user.set(key, data);
      } catch (err) {
        console.error(`Failed to persist key: ${key}`, err);
      }
    }

    async function scanMcpTools() {
      if (!archestraSDKReady) return;
      try {
        const toolsList = await window.archestra.tools.list();
        console.log("Assigned upstream MCP Tools:", toolsList);
        updateEmailPillUI();
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn("Could not retrieve tool list:", err);
      }
    }

      const permBadge = document.getElementById("scanner-perm-badge");
      if (permBadge) {
        if (state.emailPermission) {
          permBadge.textContent = "Access Granted";
          permBadge.className = "text-[10px] font-semibold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-500 border border-emerald-500/20";
        } else {
          permBadge.textContent = "Permission Required";
          permBadge.className = "text-[10px] font-semibold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-500 border border-amber-500/20";
        }
      }

      const autoscanToggle = document.getElementById("toggle-autoscan");
      if (autoscanToggle) {
        autoscanToggle.checked = state.autoScanOnLaunch;
      }
    }

    function requestEmailPermission() {
      if (!state.emailPermission) {
        document.getElementById("email-permission-modal").classList.remove("hidden");
      } else {
        if (confirm("Email access is currently GRANTED. Do you want to run an email scan now? (Click Cancel to revoke access)")) {
          runAutomatedEmailScanner();
        } else {
          revokeEmailPermission();
        }
      }
    }

    function closeEmailModal() {
      document.getElementById("email-permission-modal").classList.add("hidden");
    }

    async function grantEmailPermissionAndScan() {
      closeEmailModal();
      state.emailPermission = true;
      await persistKey("synapse-email-perm", true);
      updateEmailPillUI();
      postSystemNotice("Email Permission Granted", "Synapse AI was granted access to inspect emails for actionable items.");
      await runAutomatedEmailScanner();
    }

    async function revokeEmailPermission() {
      state.emailPermission = false;
      state.autoScanOnLaunch = false;
      await persistKey("synapse-email-perm", false);
      await persistKey("synapse-autoscan-launch", false);
      updateEmailPillUI();
      postSystemNotice("Email Permission Revoked", "Email access was revoked.");
    }

    async function toggleAutoScanSetting(enabled) {
      state.autoScanOnLaunch = enabled;
      await persistKey("synapse-autoscan-launch", enabled);
      if (enabled && !state.emailPermission) {
        requestEmailPermission();
      }
    }

    function triggerEmailScanWithPermission() {
      if (!state.emailPermission) {
        requestEmailPermission();
      } else {
        runAutomatedEmailScanner();
      }
    }

    async function runAutomatedEmailScanner() {
      if (!state.emailPermission) {
        requestEmailPermission();
        return;
      }

      const btn = document.getElementById("btn-scan-emails");
      const scanText = document.getElementById("scan-btn-text");
      const scanIcon = document.getElementById("scan-icon");
      const resultsBox = document.getElementById("email-scan-results");
      const summaryText = document.getElementById("scan-summary-text");
      const timeBadge = document.getElementById("scan-time-badge");

      btn.disabled = true;
      scanIcon.className = "w-4 h-4 animate-spin";
      scanText.textContent = "Scanning...";

      try {
        let emailsToAnalyze = [];

                else if (res.messages) emailsToAnalyze = res.messages;
                else if (typeof res === 'string') emailsToAnalyze = [{ body: res }];

            }

` + JSON.stringify(emailsToAnalyze);

    function setTimerMode(mode) {
      if (state.timerRunning) {
        if (!confirm("Are you sure you want to interrupt this session and switch modes?")) {
          return;
        }
        stopTimer();
      }
      
      state.timerMode = mode;
      state.timerDuration = DURATIONS[mode];
      state.timerRemaining = DURATIONS[mode];
      
      const selectors = ['work', 'short', 'long'];
      selectors.forEach(m => {
        const btn = document.getElementById(`btn-mode-${m}`);
        if (m === mode) {
          btn.className = "px-3 py-1 rounded-md font-medium bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 shadow-sm text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 transition-all cursor-pointer";
        } else {
          btn.className = "px-3 py-1 rounded-md font-medium text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-800 dark:hover:text-slate-100 transition-all cursor-pointer";
        }
      });
      
      const label = document.getElementById("timer-state-label");
      if (mode === 'work') {
        label.textContent = "Focus State";
        label.className = "text-xs uppercase tracking-widest font-semibold text-emerald-500 mt-1";
      } else {
        label.textContent = "Break State";
        label.className = "text-xs uppercase tracking-widest font-semibold text-blue-400 mt-1";
      }
      
      updateTimerDisplay();
      triggerAudioNotification();
    }

    function updateTimerDisplay() {
      const minutes = Math.floor(state.timerRemaining / 60);
      const seconds = state.timerRemaining % 60;
      const formatted = `${minutes.toString().padStart(2, '0')}:${seconds.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
      
      document.getElementById("timer-display").textContent = formatted;
      
      const circleCircumference = 527;
      const progressFraction = state.timerRemaining / state.timerDuration;
      const offset = circleCircumference * (1 - progressFraction);
      document.getElementById("pomodoro-progress").setAttribute("stroke-dashoffset", offset);
    }

    function toggleTimer() {
      if (state.timerRunning) {
        stopTimer();
      } else {
        startTimer();
      }
    }

    function startTimer() {
      state.timerRunning = true;
      document.getElementById("text-timer-toggle").textContent = "Pause Session";
      document.getElementById("icon-timer-toggle").setAttribute("data-lucide", "pause");
      lucide.createIcons();
      
      if (state.soundEnabled) {
        startAmbientAudio();
      }

      triggerAudioNotification();

      timerInterval = setInterval(() => {
        if (state.timerRemaining > 0) {
          state.timerRemaining--;
          updateTimerDisplay();
        } else {
          handleTimerCompletion();
        }
      }, 1000);
    }

    function stopTimer() {
      state.timerRunning = false;
      document.getElementById("text-timer-toggle").textContent = "Resume Session";
      document.getElementById("icon-timer-toggle").setAttribute("data-lucide", "play");
      lucide.createIcons();

    function resetTimer() {
      stopTimer();
      state.timerRemaining = state.timerDuration;
      document.getElementById("text-timer-toggle").textContent = "Start Session";
      document.getElementById("icon-timer-toggle").setAttribute("data-lucide", "play");
      lucide.createIcons();

    function beep() {
      try {
        const actx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
        const osc = actx.createOscillator();
        const gain = actx.createGain();
        
        osc.type = "sine";
        osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(880, actx.currentTime);
        osc.connect(gain);
        gain.connect(actx.destination);
        
        gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.3, actx.currentTime);
        gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, actx.currentTime + 1.0);
        
        osc.start();
        osc.stop(actx.currentTime + 1.0);
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn("Sound alert error:", err);
      }
    }

      if (state.soundEnabled) {

        icon.setAttribute("data-lucide", "volume-2");
        if (state.timerRunning) {
          startAmbientAudio();
        }
      } else {
        btn.className = "p-2 rounded-lg bg-emerald-500/10 hover:bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-500 transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 font-medium cursor-pointer";
        icon.setAttribute("data-lucide", "volume-x");
        stopAmbientAudio();
      }
      lucide.createIcons();
    }

    function startAmbientAudio() {
      try {
        if (!audioCtx) {
          audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
        }
        
        if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') {
          audioCtx.resume();
        }

        const bufferSize = 2 * audioCtx.sampleRate;
        const noiseBuffer = audioCtx.createBuffer(1, bufferSize, audioCtx.sampleRate);
        const output = noiseBuffer.getChannelData(0);
        
        let lastOut = 0.0;
        for (let i = 0; i < bufferSize; i++) {
          const white = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
          output[i] = (lastOut + (0.02 * white)) / 1.02;
          lastOut = output[i];
          output[i] *= 3.5;
        }
        
        rainSource = audioCtx.createBufferSource();
        rainSource.buffer = noiseBuffer;
        rainSource.loop = true;
        
        const filter = audioCtx.createBiquadFilter();
        filter.type = 'lowpass';
        filter.frequency.value = state.timerMode === 'work' ? 450 : 800; 

        gainNode = audioCtx.createGain();
        gainNode.gain.setValueAtTime(0, audioCtx.currentTime);
        gainNode.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.15, audioCtx.currentTime + 1.5);

        rainSource.connect(filter);
        filter.connect(gainNode);
        gainNode.connect(audioCtx.destination);
        
        rainSource.start();
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn("Failed procedural audio start:", e);
      }
    }

    function stopAmbientAudio() {
      try {
        if (gainNode && audioCtx) {
          gainNode.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.5);
          setTimeout(() => {
            if (rainSource) {
              rainSource.stop();
              rainSource.disconnect();
              rainSource = null;
            }
          }, 600);
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.log(e);
      }
    }

    async function generateDailyBrief() {
      if (!archestraSDKReady) {
        alert("Daily compilation is available when executing inside the secure platform workspace.");
        return;
      }

      const btn = document.getElementById("btn-generate-brief");
      const briefDisplay = document.getElementById("brief-display");
      const briefContent = document.getElementById("brief-content");
      const spinner = document.getElementById("brief-spinner");
      const text = document.getElementById("text-generate-brief");

      spinner.className = "w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin";
      text.textContent = "AI Orchestrator Compiling...";
      btn.disabled = true;

      const payload = {
        tasks: state.tasks.filter(t => !t.completed).map(t => `[${t.priority}] ${t.text}`),
        schedule: state.events.map(e => `${e.start}-${e.end}: ${e.title} (${e.type})`),
        bulletins: state.notices.map(n => n.title + ": " + n.text)
      };

      const systemPrompt = "You are Synapse AI, a highly structured workspace efficiency expert. Analyze the user's upcoming tasks, bulletins, and schedule. Synthesize an extreme 3-point daily agenda, a 1-sentence motivation, and a matching sound-palette recommendation based on their priority load.";
      
      const userPrompt = `
Analyze the following workstation payload:
TASKS:
${payload.tasks.join("\n") || "No remaining tasks!"}

SCHEDULE:
${payload.schedule.join("\n") || "No calendar events scheduled!"}

BULLETINS:
${payload.bulletins.join("\n") || "No active bulletins."}

Compile a clean text summary. Do not use markdown headers (# or ##), use bullet marks and spacing. Give:
1. FOCUS OBJECTIVE (Top priority of the day)
2. TIME BLOCK STRATEGY (How to sequence tasks into the calendar)
3. SOUND TRACK SUGGESTION (Specify either Lofi Focus, Synthwave Productivity, or Ambient Rain based on focus needs)
`;

      try {
        const aiResponse = await window.archestra.llm.complete(userPrompt, {
          system: systemPrompt
        });

        state.dailyBrief = aiResponse;
        await persistKey("synapse-brief", aiResponse);

        briefContent.textContent = aiResponse;
        briefDisplay.classList.remove("hidden");
        
        briefDisplay.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });

        suggestPlaylistByAI(aiResponse);

      } catch (err) {
        console.error("AI Completion Error:", err);
        alert("Failed to compile AI brief: " + (err.message || "quota limit / connectivity check"));
      } finally {
        spinner.className = "w-3.5 h-3.5";
        text.textContent = "Compile AI Daily Brief";
        btn.disabled = false;
        lucide.createIcons();
      }
    }

    function suggestPlaylistByAI(briefText) {
      const lower = briefText.toLowerCase();
      let match = 'lofi';
      if (lower.includes('synthwave')) match = 'synthwave';
      if (lower.includes('ambient') || lower.includes('rain')) match = 'ambient';
      if (lower.includes('classical') || lower.includes('piano')) match = 'classical';
      
      const select = document.getElementById("focus-playlist-select");
      if (select && select.value !== match) {
        select.value = match;
        updateSelectedPlaylist();
        postSystemNotice("AI Recommendation", `Synapse AI adjusted focus audio palette to "${PLAYLISTS[match].title}".`);
      }
    }

    async function parseEmailContent() {
      const textInput = document.getElementById("email-textarea");
      if (!textInput.value.trim()) {
        alert("Please paste some email text, meeting notes, or chat feeds to extract actions!");
        return;
      }

      if (!archestraSDKReady) {
        alert("Platform secure AI parsing is only available inside the platform sandbox.");
        return;
      }

      const btn = document.getElementById("btn-parse-email");
      const spinner = document.getElementById("parse-spinner");
      
      btn.disabled = true;
      spinner.className = "w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin";

      const systemPrompt = "You are Synapse Action Extractor. Parse the pasted raw email or briefing. Extract exact actionable tasks and key informative alerts/notices. Return a strict JSON response containing a 'tasks' array (each with 'text' and 'priority' [high/medium/low]) and a 'notices' array (each with 'title' and 'text'). Do not return any other commentary.";
      
      try {
        const responseText = await window.archestra.llm.complete(textInput.value, {
          system: systemPrompt,
          jsonMode: true
        });

        const parsed = JSON.parse(responseText);

        let addedCount = 0;

        if (parsed.tasks && parsed.tasks.length > 0) {
          parsed.tasks.forEach(task => {
            state.tasks.unshift({
              id: crypto.randomUUID(),
              text: task.text,
              completed: false,
              priority: task.priority || 'medium',
              date: new Date().toISOString()
            });
            addedCount++;
          });
          await persistKey("synapse-tasks", state.tasks);
        }

        if (parsed.notices && parsed.notices.length > 0) {
          parsed.notices.forEach(notice => {
            state.notices.unshift({
              id: crypto.randomUUID(),
              title: notice.title || "Extracted Notice",
              text: notice.text,
              category: "fyi",
              date: new Date().toISOString(),
              pinned: false
            });
            addedCount++;
          });
          await persistKey("synapse-notices", state.notices);
        }

        if (addedCount > 0) {
          textInput.value = "";
          renderTasks();
          renderNotices();
          alert(`Successfully extracted and imported ${parsed.tasks?.length || 0} tasks and ${parsed.notices?.length || 0} notices directly into your dashboard!`);
        } else {
          alert("Synapse AI analyzed the text but did not find any highly defined actionable tasks or notices.");
        }

      } catch (err) {
        console.error("AI Email Parse Error:", err);
        alert("Extracted parser failed: " + (err.message || "JSON shape alignment issue"));
      } finally {
        btn.disabled = false;
        spinner.className = "w-3.5 h-3.5";
        lucide.createIcons();
      }
    }

    function copyBriefText() {
      const briefContent = document.getElementById("brief-content").textContent;
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(briefContent);
      alert("AI daily brief copied to clipboard!");
    }

    function renderAll() {
      renderTasks();
      renderCalendar();
      renderNotices();
      updateTimerDisplay();
      updateEmailPillUI();
      
      const playlistSel = document.getElementById("focus-playlist-select");
      if (playlistSel) playlistSel.value = state.selectedPlaylist;
      const activeTrack = document.getElementById("spotify-active-track");
      if (activeTrack) activeTrack.textContent = PLAYLISTS[state.selectedPlaylist].title;
      
      if (state.dailyBrief) {
        document.getElementById("brief-content").textContent = state.dailyBrief;
        document.getElementById("brief-display").classList.remove("hidden");
      }
    }
  </script>

ct as an expert full-stack developer and AI systems architect. I want to build a modern, AI-powered productivity dashboard. The core value proposition of this app is that it uses the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to securely connect to my Spotify and Email accounts to automate my daily workflow.

A Pomodoro-style Timer: For deep work sessions.

A Task Section: A to-do list for actionable items.

A Notice Section: A bulletin board for important updates or FYIs that don't require action.
